rationale: Select these 15 advisors around existing-sme, source hash 3719c58530161598ab9a537a43be749a5287c8d8dbd35b855e5afea97cd15258. Every proposal must identify its base and concrete change. These are unverified research directions. The fresh baseline spans 998.06–1546.06 GFLOP/s; promotion requires fresh paired controls under unchanged gates. Historical results cannot establish current eligibility or individual-advisor credit.
